attrs.note: datasheet - the material (PVC rated UL 94V-0), the standards (ANSI/TIA 568, cULus listed), the covers and the accessories are the specification sheet's.

capacity.note: datasheet - Leviton's application note "Maximum Cable Fill Ratios in Cable Managers" (NS-AN-23-006-05-30-23, 5/30/2023), page 15, "VERSI-DUCT Horizontal Cable Managers Front Channel Capacities": "2RU Horizontal Cable Manager 8.25 sq.in. (492RU-HFR, -HFO)" and, for the 6AS10 patch cord (0.240 in), 91 cords at 50 percent fill, 54 at 30 percent, 45 at 25 percent. It states 30 percent as the "recommended practical maximum" for patch cords in front managers. It names the cord by Leviton part number and not by category, so no `cable-capacity-media` is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - 444.5 x 88.3 x 84.46. The plate is 19.0054 in [482.74mm] wide over its ears, 3.475 in [88.27mm] high, and its top and bottom edges fold back from 19.15 to 463.65 on the top view, so the flat ends outside the folds are the ears, which this library does not draw, and the body is the 444.5 (17.50 in on the specification sheet's top view).

color.note: estimated - the specification sheet sells the ducts "with black covers" and names no colour for the duct; every drawing is line work, so the whole is this library's render of black PVC. The product page states no colour.

cover.note: datasheet - the cover ships fitted: the specification sheet lists the duct "with black covers" and calls it a "snap-on duct cover"; the instruction sheet (Versi-Duct Slotted Duct System, horizontal slotted duct, step 2) says to "fit the cover over the top of duct fingers. Push down and rotate the cover to the other side until it snaps into place." It is drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`. A hinge for it (49265-HNG, "Duct Cover Hinge") is a separate accessory.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are the flat ends of the mounting plate at the back of the duct: the top view of the 492RU-HFO dimensional drawing dimensions 3.325 in [84.46mm] from the front of the cover to the back of the plate, which is the whole depth, so `at` is 84.46 and nothing stands behind the rail. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front channel with its cover fitted: the side view's outline is 3.38 in [85.9mm] over the cover and the finger tips, 3.0 in [76.2mm] over the walls (6.03 to 82.23). The two walls stand 6.04 mm in from the top and bottom of the plate; the channel's clear size is 2.75 in x 3.00 in [69.85 x 76.2mm], 8.25 sq in, in Leviton's application note. The cover is the 17.5 in [444.5mm] one the specification sheet names.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the duct stands wholly in front of the rail, 84.46 mm, and the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the duct is the channel between the two finger walls, run across the rack; its finger pitch (49.375) and slot gap (22.45) are the top view figures above, and its size the 69.85 mm of clear height Leviton's application note gives.

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the drawing's side view: the plate, the two finger walls 6.04 mm in from its top and bottom edges, and the cover's plate and lips over their tips. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DIMENSIONAL DRAWING. Leviton publishes the 492RU-HFO drawing as DXF and DWG on its product page; the DXF is vector CAD in inches, five views (front, top, bottom, side and isometric), with the dimensions 3.475 in, 3.325 in and 19.0054 in. The assembly in the drawing includes the cover ("w/ cover"). Every figure here is read from its line work at 25.4 mm to the inch. The specification sheet (Versi-Duct Horizontal Cable Management System, revised June 2022) draws the 2RU duct's side view and top view with the cover on, and gives part numbers and sizes.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the plate, plain. The isometric shows it as one flat sheet with the ear slots at each end, which are not drawn.

thickness.note: drawing - the walls of the fingers are 2.54 mm [0.1 in] on the side view and the plate 3.04, from its two faces 81.41 and 84.45 mm from the front on the 492RU-HFR's.

top.note: drawing - an elevation, rear at the top of the drawing: the plate, then the finger wall with nine slots 22.45 wide on a 49.375 pitch, each running from the finger tips 24.15 mm from the front back to the plate, and the cover over the front 22.8 mm. The bottom is the same from underneath.

weight.note: no document states a weight: the specification sheet, the product page and the instruction sheet are silent. `weight-kg` is left out and a gap says so.
